scripts.docker:db: docker compose up -d db && node scripts/docker-status.mjs
scripts.docker:db:stop: docker compose stop db && node scripts/docker-status.mjs
scripts.docker:db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d avash
scripts.docker:ml:build: docker compose --profile ml build ml && node scripts/docker-status.mjs
scripts.docker:apps: docker compose --profile apps up -d && node scripts/docker-status.mjs
scripts.docker:apps:down: docker compose --profile apps down && node scripts/docker-status.mjs
